title: Stream message (connector protocol 1.1)
description: One message of a stream: an item, a deletion, a completed listing or a source state. Open: a receiver ignores fields it does not know. Types record, principal, group, membership and permission are reserved; every 1.1 receiver refuses them with unsupported_type.

source.description: The workspace source key. Not the runner's source_key fact.

external_id.description: The item's key in the source; for GitHub its path in the repository.

version.description: The source's own version of the original; for GitHub the blob sha (the git hash of the raw bytes). Never compared with content_hash.

content_hash.description: The Brain's hash of the normalised text that is uploaded. Never compared with version.

payload.description: What the message carries; its shape depends on type.

state.description: The source's own position after everything before this message, for example the commit read. Opaque to every receiver but the component that wrote it.

generation_payload.description: The end of a complete listing of the source: what was not listed in it may be retired, under the deletion guard. Open.

counts.description: Items listed, by name of the count; whole numbers only.
